title: Accenture to Acquire Alfahealth, Expanding Digital Health Capabilities to Accelerate Healthcare Transformation in Italy
snippet: Alfahealth brings more than two decades of experience developing and operating technology capabilities, delivered as part of its services-plus-product model to support patient journeys, including clinical...
fullText:
Alfahealth brings more than two decades of experience developing and operating technology capabilities, delivered as part of its services-plus-product model to support patient journeys, including clinical workflows and diagnostics, as well as administrative and operational processes. Its technology enables providers to connect data and support new, more integrated models of care at the scale and regulatory rigor demanded by the Italian market.

        

          

            
            
            
            
          

        

        

The acquisition reflects Accenture’s continued strategy to combine services, software, data and AI-powered platforms, using an integrated services and product commercial model, so clients achieve sustainable end-to-end transformation. Alfahealth’s positioning in the industry will be further enhanced with Accenture’s capabilities in data, AI, cybersecurity and cloud.

        

“Italy is at a pivotal moment in the transformation of its healthcare system, with growing investments in digital health, interoperability and new models of care,” said Teodoro Lio, Market Unit Lead for Accenture in Italy. “Alfahealth brings deep healthcare expertise, trusted relationships with healthcare organizations across Italy and capabilities for digitizing and orchestrating the clinical and administrative processes of our healthcare ecosystem. Together, we will help healthcare providers and institutions accelerate innovation, improve care delivery and enable more connected, data-driven and personalized experiences for all Italians, powered by data and artificial intelligence.”

        

Alfahealth brings approximately 1,200 specialized professionals to Accenture Italy’s Health practice, and a strong position in the Italian healthcare sector, supporting relevant national programs in a regulated environment.

        

Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. Completion of the acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions.

title: Accenture and Dell Technologies Expand Collaboration to Help Enterprises Scale Private AI and Modernize Infrastructure
snippet: Accenture and Dell Technologies today announced a major expansion of their 20+ year collaboration with the formation of the Accenture Dell Business Group, designed to help organizations scale AI within their own environment and modernize their infrastructure. Together, the companies can give enterprises greater control over their data, more predictable economics, and the performance needed to run enterprise-grade agentic AI workloads.
fullText:
“By expanding our collaboration with Dell, we’re strengthening the power of our organizations to help our clients move from AI ambition to scaled execution to measurable business outcomes," said Julie Sweet, chair and CEO, Accenture. "Enterprises will be able to deploy AI solutions faster, align them with their business priorities, maintain greater control through private, hybrid and sovereign environments, and optimize both cost and performance."

        

          

            
            
            
            
          

        

        

“Dell Technologies and Accenture bring a deep history of working side-by-side to help our customers unlock their biggest opportunities,” said Michael Dell, chairman and CEO, Dell Technologies. “The formation of a dedicated business group deepens that collaboration to help enterprises move from AI interest to adoption. By bringing together Accenture’s strategic and industry expertise with Dell’s AI-ready infrastructure and services, we’re helping customers streamline business processes and build the full-stack capabilities needed to deploy AI at scale.”

        

The Accenture Dell Business Group builds on a strong track record of helping clients in industries such as financial services, life sciences, manufacturing, industrials and high-tech use AI to transform their businesses. It is uniquely positioned to help organizations deploy AI on private infrastructure, leveraging relationships with sovereign and neo cloud providers.

        

For RHAELM, a UK-based AI infrastructure and solutions provider, Accenture and Dell are contributing to accelerating the delivery of its sovereign cloud solutions, focused on secure, compliant, high-performing operations.

        

“By leveraging Dell’s AI-ready infrastructure and services and Accenture’s deep industry and transformation expertise, we are enabling our clients to deploy cutting-edge sovereign AI at pace and scale,” said Bradd Lewis, CEO and CRO, RHAELM. “The Accenture Dell Business Group brings a deeper level of collaboration that directly benefits our clients.”

        

To support the Accenture Dell Business Group, Accenture plans to train more than 3,000 practitioners to build deep capability and expertise across the Dell portfolio. This group will deliver comprehensive solutions to help organizations complement their cloud strategies with on-premises AI infrastructure — particularly for those in highly regulated industries. Together, these capabilities provide a unified approach to accelerating AI adoption while aligning technology investments to business outcomes:

        

          

Private AI and neocloud solutions: Designed to help organizations enhance control over data, compliance, and performance through scalable and secure AI Factories built with full-stack solutions consisting of Dell’s end-to-end portfolio and ecosystem partners, supported by full lifecycle services from Dell and Accenture.

          

Integrated private AI stack offerings: Enterprise AI infrastructure brings together Dell’s complete, fully integrated solutions to support agentic AI, inferencing and high-performance computing workloads through Accenture’s full-stack offerings.

          

Accelerated agentic solutions deployment: Agentic use cases and accelerators help drive faster time-to-value from scaled AI use cases.

          

Open source and open-weight models: Designed to support model selection and task‑aware routing across models and environments, helping to maintain cost predictability, data control and scalable AI operations on a pre-defined private infrastructure stack.

        

        

Learn more about the Accenture and Dell Technologies collaboration here.

        

About Accenture

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.
